title: Lula Positions Brazil as Global Player in US Visit Focused on Tariffs and Rare Earths
detail: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's visit to the United States centers on tariff negotiations and rare earth minerals, as Brazil seeks to leverage US-China trade tensions to strengthen its strategic global standing. The visit underscores Brazil's ambition to act as an independent power broker amid shifting global trade alignments.

media.caption: President Lula da Silva in Washington for talks on tariffs and rare earths
